title: Visualize History
outro_say: That's Visualize History. | Next: what followed.

steps.screen: A scan of Volatility squeeze: pressing 🕰️
steps.say: Visualize History shows what a Set said on every past day. | Open a scan, and press the clock.

steps.screen: The main chart with its bands
steps.say: The price is drawn with coloured bands behind it. | Green is Yes. Amber is Unknown. | No is left clear.
Underneath, every other asset in the scan gets a small chart of its own, with the same bands. | So you can compare them at a glance.
Tap a small chart, and that asset moves to the top.
Choose how far back to look: one year, three, or everything. | You can also zoom and drag along the time axis.

steps.screen: Open on the main price chart
steps.say: Open on the main price chart takes the asset and its bands to your dashboard chart.

steps.screen: A card: what the bands are, and aren't
steps.say: The bands show when the conditions were met. | They don't say what happened next. | That is the job of the next video.
